_note: VETTED CONNECTOR + BINDING CEILING — the single policy source for which MCP/analytics/store/Grok CLI binding MAY live on which provider, plus concrete public IDs. It is not proof of installed or callable access. Effective access is this ceiling intersected with fresh observed runtime/session state from bin/detect-integrations.py and role-specific preflight. Policy prose points here and bin/connectors.py renders prompt packets. When a connector's authorized seats move, edit ONLY this file; user install/remove/enable/disable actions are detected separately. This file holds NO secrets — connector NAMES and public IDs only; keys/tokens never live in the repo.
_status_lifecycle: Each mcp_connectors entry MUST carry an explicit status: active | ready | primed. Missing or unknown status is INERT. active means eligible inside the policy ceiling, not observed live: routing additionally requires bin/integrations.py observed-effective proof. primed/ready/missing/unknown remain unroutable. A primed/ready entry may carry an OPTIONAL server descriptor as DATA only; no script executes it. Credentials NEVER live here: env_keys names variables only. Strap-in and observation rules: mcp-routing.md.
_risk_note: CONCENTRATION RISK (known, disclosed): the Shopify and DataForSEO (dfs) integrations ride ONE shared OAuth/KV credential surface — a compromise, token expiry, or outage of that surface can take BOTH down together. Treat them as a single blast radius (one auth-failure / correlated-outage class), not two independent connectors, when routing around an outage (EDGE-CASES.md) or reasoning about secret exposure.
